نبتدر (form VIII)
# نَبْتَدِرُ (nabtadiru) /nab.ta.di.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَدَرَ (ibtadara)
# نُبْتَدَرُ (nubtadaru) /nub.ta.da.ru/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَدَرَ (ibtadara)
# نَبْتَدِرَ (nabtadira) /nab.ta.di.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِبْتَدَرَ (ibtadara)
# نُبْتَدَرَ (nubtadara) /nub.ta.da.ra/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
